preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner
Attacker must hold some amount of the CoinToken to perform swaps

exploit_hint: The vulnerability is in the updateUniswapV2Router function which lacks validation of the pair address parameter. As owner, call updateUniswapV2Router with a malicious router address that returns a fake WETH address. Then call setAutomatedMarketMakerPair with a fake pair address controlled by the attacker. This allows bypassing fee mechanisms when transferring to/from the fake pair, enabling the attacker to buy tokens without paying fees and sell them with fees, draining contract ETH from swapAndLiquify and swapAndSendDividends functions.
